extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, applicants, agents/attorneys, and patent examiners
extracted.subtask_description: Manual of Patent Examining Procedure chapter outlining the duty of disclosure, candor, and good faith under 37 CFR 1.56 and related USPTO practice; intended as rules and standards for disclosing information to the Office and handling inequitable conduct issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table-of-contents heading for the chapter; full explanatory text and legal standards appear in the MPEP chapter itself (not present on this TOC page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — introduces scope and purpose of the Duty of Disclosure chapter in the MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duty of Disclosure, Candor, and Good Faith
rubrics_metrics.description: 2001: Duty of Disclosure, Candor, and Good Faith
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — denotes the fundamental obligation of applicants/agents to disclose material information and act with candor and good faith before the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who Has Duty To Disclose
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — identifies categories of persons (e.g., inventors, attorneys/agents, others associated with the filing/prosecution) subject to the duty of disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reserved (2001.02)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section reserved in MPEP; no substantive guidance on this TOC page.

rubrics_metrics.name: To Whom Duty of Disclosure Is Owed
rubrics_metrics.description: 2001.03: To Whom Duty of Disclosure Is Owed
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — addresses the addressee of the duty (e.g., the United States Patent and Trademark Office).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Under 37 CFR 1.56(a)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — pertains to the types of information that must be disclosed under the regulation (e.g., known prior art, material information).

rubrics_metrics.name: Materiality Under 37 CFR 1.56(b)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — covers the materiality standard for determining whether information must be disclosed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sources of Information under 37 CFR 1.56
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — lists and discusses common sources of information that may be material and must be considered for disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Art Cited in Related Foreign Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: 2001.06(a): Prior Art Cited in Related Foreign Applications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — addresses disclosure obligations regarding prior art cited in related foreign filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Relating to or From Copending United States Patent Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: 2001.06(b): Information Relating to or From Copending United States Patent Applications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — discusses materiality and disclosure considerations for information from copending U.S. applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information From Related Litigation and/or Trial Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: 2001.06(c): Information From Related Litigation and/or Trial Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — covers disclosure duties when relevant information arises from litigation or trials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Relating to Claims Copied From a Patent
rubrics_metrics.description: 2001.06(d): Information Relating to Claims Copied From a Patent
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — treats special considerations where claims are copied from an earlier patent, and associated disclosure duties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Relating to Regulatory Review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — addresses obligations to disclose information arising from regulatory review (e.g., FDA filings) that may be material to patentability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure — By Whom and How Made
rubrics_metrics.description: 2002: Disclosure — By Whom and How Made
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — covers procedural aspects of who must make disclosures and the method/form of disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: By Whom Made
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — identifies responsible parties for making disclosures to the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Must be in Writing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — states the requirement that disclosures be submitted in writing (procedural requirement under MPEP/37 CFR).

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure (general)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — general discussion of disclosure obligations and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure After Patent Is Granted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — addresses obligations and procedures for disclosing information discovered after grant (e.g., potential actions, duty to correct).

rubrics_metrics.name: Aids to Compliance With Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: 2004: Aids to Compliance With Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — suggests tools, procedures, or best practices to help practitioners comply with disclosure duties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparison to Requirements for Information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — compares the duty of disclosure to other formal requirements for submission of information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reserved (2006)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section reserved in MPEP; no substantive guidance on this TOC page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office Handling of Duty of Disclosure/Inequitable Conduct Issues
rubrics_metrics.description: 2010: Office Handling of Duty of Disclosure/Inequitable Conduct Issues
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — discusses how the USPTO handles allegations, investigations, and procedures related to inequitable conduct and disclosure violations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction of Errors in Application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — addresses procedures and standards for correcting errors in an application that may implicate disclosure duties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reissue Applications Involving Issues of Fraud, Inequitable Conduct, and/or Violation of Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: 2012: Reissue Applications Involving Issues of Fraud, Inequitable Conduct, and/or Violation of Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — covers how reissue practice intersects with allegations of fraud or disclosure violations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collateral Estoppel
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — addresses preclusion doctrines (collateral estoppel) relevant to inequitable conduct and duty of disclosure issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protests Involving Issues of Fraud, Inequitable Conduct, and/or Violation of Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: 2013: Protests Involving Issues of Fraud, Inequitable Conduct, and/or Violation of Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — discusses how protests before the Office may raise or involve disclosure/inequitable conduct concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duty of Disclosure in Reexamination Proceedings and Supplemental Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: 2014: Duty of Disclosure in Reexamination Proceedings and Supplemental Examination
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — covers disclosure obligations and Office handling in post-grant reexamination and supplemental examination contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duties of Disclosure and Reasonable Inquiry Arise in Dealings With Other Government Agencies
rubrics_metrics.description: 2015: Duties of Disclosure and Reasonable Inquiry Arise in Dealings With Other Government Agencies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry only — discusses how duty and reasonable inquiry obligations can arise through interactions with other government bodies.
